name: Spain

authorities.competent_authority: AEMPS (Spanish Agency for Medicines and Medical Devices) issues the national authorisation.
authorities.ethics: A Spanish Research Ethics Committee for medicinal products (CEIm) validates and evaluates Part II. The sponsor agrees on the assessing CEIm before submission, contacts a CEIm that participates in CTIS work, confirms it can assess on the intended dates, and identifies it in the cover letter. For minors the CEIm needs paediatric expertise or advice; for adults unable to consent, relevant disease expertise or clinical, ethical and psychosocial advice.
authorities.fee: Proof of the AEMPS assessment fee is uploaded in the CTIS Form, not Part II (mandatory unless exempt). A sponsor claiming the non-commercial exemption uploads the required signed declaration instead. The selected CEIm must be identified during fee payment.
authorities.cover_letter: Identify the agreed assessing CEIm; where the protocol fully describes recruitment, identify where (no separate K1 then).
authorities.before_site_start: Favourable CEIm opinion, AEMPS authorisation decision, signed contract with the site, and activation of the site in the Spanish Clinical Studies Registry (REec).

language_rules.rule: Part II documents addressed to trial participants and assessed by the CEIm must be written only in Spanish (including recruitment material). Most administrative Part II documents may be in Spanish or English; the insurance document must be in Spanish.
language_rules.non_spanish_speakers: If a participant needs another language, the sponsor provides an accurate translation; these additional translations are not submitted to the CEIm under the national instruction. An impartial witness is not a substitute for a translation or interpreter.
language_rules.form_answers: Part II forms (shared EU templates in content/eu/templates/part-ii) are answered in Spanish; English is also accepted for the administrative forms (see DECISIONS.md).

study_facts_note: Keys not in playbook/planning.md section 2 (Spain-specific): population.non_spanish_speakers, recruitment.procedure_fully_in_protocol, substudy.optional_subpopulation, trial.non_commercial, insurance.international_policy_exclusions, insurance.low_intervention_site_liability_cover, compensation.offered, compensation.eu_template_used, budget.individual_site_budgets. See DECISIONS.md.

documents.unless: recruitment.procedure_fully_in_protocol (a separate document is then not needed, but the cover letter must identify where the protocol describes the process; see DECISIONS.md)

template.basis: European recruitment and informed-consent procedure template, version 2.0 (European Commission, version dated 1 June 2026); mandatory version for all new Part II submissions after 1 September 2026, including initial applications, additional Member State applications and Part II submissions completing an Article 11 application

documents.content: How potential participants are identified and approached, including the first act of recruitment; each recruitment item (K2) and how and where it is used; how information is given and consent obtained. Every consent pathway in the plan (adults unable to consent, minors, impartial witness, emergency) needs its section completed with the Spanish rules in national_fields.
documents.drafting_notes_es: CTIS Parte II, sección K («Recruitment arrangements»). Información obligatoria. Un documento separado no es necesario si el protocolo describe completamente el proceso; en ese caso la carta de presentación debe indicar dónde figura esa información. Español o inglés; respuestas de esta plantilla en español. Sin firma en la presentación. Para todas las nuevas presentaciones de Parte II desde el 1 de septiembre de 2026 (solicitudes iniciales, Estados miembros adicionales y Parte II que completa una solicitud del artículo 11) usar la versión 2.0 de la plantilla europea. Describir cómo se identifica y contacta a los posibles participantes, incluido el primer acto de reclutamiento, y explicar cada material de reclutamiento (K2) y cómo y dónde se usará. Completar la sección de cada vía de consentimiento del plan (adultos incapaces, menores, testigo imparcial, urgencia) con los requisitos españoles indicados en national_fields; responder «no aplicable» en las secciones que no apliquen.

national_fields.v105: Spain (recruitment, Member State information): state that participant-facing recruitment material for Spain is in Spanish and submitted as a blank version; if the protocol fully describes the recruitment process, reference where (the cover letter must identify it).
national_fields.v108: Spain (informed consent, Member State information): the PIS/ICF assessed by the CEIm is in Spanish; when a participant needs another language the sponsor provides an accurate translation (not submitted to the CEIm under the national instruction); withdrawal is valid without signing a revocation form; the participant receives the PIS and a signed and dated copy of the ICF.
national_fields.v110: Spain (adults unable to consent): Royal Decree 1090/2015 articles 4 and 6: consent by the legal representative or, as appropriate, a person connected by family or factual relationship; the site verifies current legal authority and keeps the evidence; information accessible and understandable with appropriate support so that the person consents personally whenever possible; prior instructions given while capable are checked and respected; explicit objection respected; consent of the participant before continuing if capacity is regained.
national_fields.v114: Spain (minors): Royal Decree 1090/2015 articles 4 and 5 and Civil Code article 156: prior consent of the parents not deprived of parental authority or of the legal representative; one parent may sign when the other parent's express or tacit agreement is sufficiently documented (both sign / one signs and confirms the other does not object / sole legal guardian); a child younger than 12 with sufficient judgment is heard; from age 12 the minor also consents and signs; adult consent before continuing at 18; an explicit refusal or wish to withdraw is respected.
national_fields.v117: Spain (impartial witness): only for a capable participant unable to read or write; the witness is impartial and unrelated to the study, with full name and role recorded; a study staff member reads the PIS; the AEMPS Annex VIIIA "Informed Consent before witnesses" model is used; not used for language barriers, incapacity or emergencies; an interpreter is not automatically the witness.
national_fields.v121: Spain (emergency): Article 35 CTR and Royal Decree 1090/2015 article 7: whenever the emergency allows, consult people connected to the participant by family or factual relationship before enrolment (who, time allowed, documentation); inform the participant or legally designated representative as soon as possible; obtain consent to continue and ratification of the participation already started; tell them of the right to object to use of data obtained in the trial.

documents.trigger_text: Advertising, letters, telephone scripts, posters, websites, social media or other recruitment materials will be used.
documents.content: Each proposed item, prepared in Spanish for use in Spain, submitted as a blank approved version, not signed. K1 explains how and where each item is used.
documents.drafting_notes_es: CTIS Parte II, sección K. Condicional: presentar cada material de reclutamiento propuesto (anuncios, cartas, guiones telefónicos, carteles, páginas web, redes sociales u otros) y explicar en K1 cómo y dónde se usará. En español, versión en blanco aprobada, sin firma. Sin plantilla nacional.

documents.name_en: Patient Information Sheet and Informed Consent Form (HIP/CI), one set per population, substudy or optional activity
documents.content: Blank Spanish PIS/ICF for the main study and separate versions for relevant populations, substudies or optional activities (population_sets). Additional distinct consent materials when the trial includes adults unable to consent, emergency enrolment, an impartial-witness process, pregnancy follow-up of a participant's partner, optional substudies or secondary use; independent choices are not hidden inside one general acceptance statement. AEMPS Annex VIIIA is the national model; AEMPS Annex VIIIB gives the biological-sample text. The participant, parent, representative, witness and investigator sign only when consent is obtained.
documents.drafting_notes_es: CTIS Parte II, sección L («Subject information and informed consent form»). Obligatorio: una HIP/CI en español por población, subestudio o actividad opcional (ver population_sets), en blanco y con control de versión. Modelo nacional: Anexo VIIIA de la AEMPS (27 de febrero de 2025); textos de muestras: Anexo VIIIB (20 de diciembre de 2017). Incluir el Apéndice 1 de protección de datos del Anexo VIIIA dentro de cada documento (ver ES-DATA-PROTECTION-APPENDIX). Título CTIS descriptivo; versión y fecha en el pie del documento y en los metadatos de CTIS, no en el título (guía CTCG v3.0). Nadie firma antes de la presentación.

documents.ctis_title_note: No title of its own: Appendix 1 is part of each L1 document and is never uploaded separately.
documents.name_en: Personal-data appendix (AEMPS Annex VIIIA Appendix 1) within the Spanish participant information
documents.templates_by_population: population_sets (each participant template carries the Appendix 1 sections)
documents.content: Annex VIIIA personal-data appendix in every Spanish participant document, uploaded only under "Subject information and informed consent form" and never duplicated as a separate national data-protection document. Identifies the sponsor and site roles, processing purposes and legal basis, confidentiality protections, retention, rights and limitations, contacts, result publication, sharing and international transfers where applicable. At most two pages.
documents.filled_by: assistant (drafted as part of each L1 document)
default_steps: Drafted within each L1 document (its Draft, Source QC, Checklist and Style steps)
documents.drafting_notes_es: Obligatorio dentro de la información al participante. Incluir el Apéndice 1 del Anexo VIIIA en cada documento español para participantes y subirlo solo bajo «Subject information and informed consent form»; no duplicarlo como documento nacional de protección de datos separado. Identificar las funciones del promotor y del centro (el centro conserva la historia clínica identificable; el promotor recibe datos codificados), base jurídica y finalidades, confidencialidad, quién accede a datos identificables, conservación (25 años promotor e investigador; historia clínica según plazo del centro), derechos y limitaciones, contactos de protección de datos, publicación de resultados, comunicación y transferencias fuera del EEE. Describir por finalidad las actividades externalizadas que requieren datos directos (viajes, reembolsos, servicios domiciliarios); no es necesario nombrar cada empresa. Máximo dos páginas, con la misma letra y el mismo interlineado mínimos.

documents.ctis_section: Form (CTIS Form section, outside the Part II placeholders)
documents.ctis_title_note: The naming guide gives no CTCG title for the GDPR statement in the Forms section ("use other CTIS upload locations"); a plain descriptive title is used. See DECISIONS.md.
documents.name_en: EU statement of compliance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679

template.basis: EudraLex statement of compliance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR); Spain requires no national data-protection sentence in it

documents.content: The CTIS Form includes the EU statement of compliance with the GDPR. It sits outside the Part II document placeholders but remains part of the application. Not an R1 Part II document for Spain: the national data-protection content is the Annex VIIIA appendix inside the participant documents.
documents.filled_by: assistant; name and role of the responsible person at the sponsor from the sponsor
documents.drafting_notes_es: Formulario CTIS (fuera de los apartados de documentos de la Parte II). Declaración UE de cumplimiento del Reglamento (UE) 2016/679. No subir en la sección R de la Parte II ni como documento nacional de protección de datos: en España la información nacional va en el Apéndice 1 del Anexo VIIIA dentro de la HIP/CI. La guía española no exige ninguna frase nacional adicional: el campo condicional r1_the_sponsor_declares no aplica y se elimina. Nombre y cargo de la persona responsable del promotor: solo de las fuentes del promotor; no inventar.

documents.content: Current CV in the CTIS "Investigator CV" subsection showing suitable clinical-trial and GCP experience, updated within the previous two years. AEMPS does not require the EU trial number in the CV.
documents.drafting_notes_es: CTIS Parte II, sección M, subsección «Investigator CV». Obligatorio para cada investigador principal. Plantilla europea de CV aceptada. Español o inglés. Debe mostrar experiencia adecuada en ensayos clínicos y en Buena Práctica Clínica y estar actualizado en los dos años anteriores. La AEMPS no exige el número UE del ensayo en el CV (puede rellenarse, no es obligatorio); su tabla CTIS no exige firma en la presentación. Los datos personales los aporta el investigador: el asistente solo rellena los datos del ensayo y no inventa datos personales.

template.basis: European declaration-of-interest template (to be used in Spain)

documents.content: Declaration of Interest in the CTIS "Suitability of the investigator" subsection, mandatory even when no conflict exists; updated within the previous year; states the relevant interests or that none exist.
documents.drafting_notes_es: CTIS Parte II, sección M, subsección «Suitability of the investigator». Obligatorio para cada investigador principal, también cuando no existe conflicto. Usar la plantilla europea de declaración. Español o inglés. Actualizada en el año anterior; debe indicar los intereses relevantes o que no existen. La tabla CTIS de la AEMPS no exige firma en la presentación. Los intereses los declara el investigador; el asistente solo rellena título del ensayo y número UE.

template.basis: European site-suitability form (CTAG); Spain accepts it or AEMPS Annex IV (Site Suitability, version 27 March 2023, not supplied)

documents.signature_note: Signed at submission by the director of the healthcare site or institution, or a delegated person. AEMPS expressly identifies this as the signed Part II document. The site completes and signs; the signed version is uploaded.
documents.content: One statement per site under the CTIS facility and site-suitability fields. Identifies the trial, department, site, planned participant number and any collaborating departments, and confirms that the site has the required staff, equipment, facilities and expertise.
documents.filled_by: assistant; site details and signature left empty for the site
documents.drafting_notes_es: CTIS Parte II, sección N (campos de idoneidad de las instalaciones y del centro). Obligatorio, un documento por centro. España acepta el formulario europeo o el Anexo IV de la AEMPS, en español o inglés. FIRMADO en la presentación por el director del centro o institución sanitaria, o persona delegada: el bloque de firma lo completa el centro y se sube la versión firmada. Debe identificar el ensayo, el servicio, el centro, el número previsto de participantes y los servicios colaboradores, y confirmar que el centro dispone del personal, equipos, instalaciones y experiencia necesarios. Nombre del centro, investigador principal y número de participantes quedan en blanco para el centro.

national_fields.n1_issued_by: Spain requires the signature at submission: the director of the healthcare site or institution, or a delegated person, signs. Leave the block empty for the site; do not delete it.
national_fields.v125: Spain: the statement must also identify the department (servicio) and any collaborating departments. Use them only if the sources give them; otherwise leave the instruction and raise missing data for the site.

documents.unless: trial.low_intervention and insurance.low_intervention_site_liability_cover (then ES-O2-LOW-INTERVENTION); a qualifying non-commercial sponsor may first submit ES-O2-NON-COMMERCIAL and provide this certificate within 30 calendar days
documents.template_note: AEMPS Annex VA, Insurance Certificate Model, version 27 March 2023: not supplied (see DECISIONS.md, Missing).
documents.signature_note: The AEMPS model has a signature line for the insurer, sponsor or site representative; submit the completed, executed certificate. No separate CTIS electronic signature.
documents.content: Proof of insurance or equivalent financial guarantee, in Spanish, on AEMPS Annex VA. Lists each participating site and principal investigator and reflects the Spanish statutory coverage limits (Royal Decree 1090/2015).
documents.drafting_notes_es: CTIS Parte II, sección O. Obligatorio salvo en ensayos de bajo nivel de intervención cubiertos por la responsabilidad civil profesional del centro. Solo en español. Modelo estándar: Anexo VA de la AEMPS; enumera cada centro participante y su investigador principal y refleja los límites de cobertura legales españoles. Certificado cumplimentado y firmado (asegurador, promotor o representante del centro); no se requiere firma electrónica adicional en CTIS. Documento del asegurador: solo se revisa.

documents.name_en: Additional sponsor responsibility commitment (AEMPS Annex VB)
documents.trigger_text: An international policy contains exclusions that may not meet Spanish coverage rules. Acceptance of the commitment is for the CEIm to decide.
documents.template_note: AEMPS Annex VB: not supplied (see DECISIONS.md, Missing).
documents.signature_note: Signed sponsor commitment (AEMPS model with signature line); no separate CTIS electronic signature.
documents.drafting_notes_es: CTIS Parte II, sección O. Condicional: compromiso adicional de responsabilidad del promotor (Anexo VB de la AEMPS) cuando una póliza internacional contiene exclusiones que pueden no cumplir las normas españolas de cobertura. Su aceptación corresponde al CEIm. En español, firmado por el promotor.

documents.name_en: Non-commercial sponsor insurance commitment (AEMPS Annex VI)
documents.trigger_text: A qualifying non-commercial sponsor initially submits the signed commitment instead of the certificate; the insurance certificate (ES-O1) must then be provided within 30 calendar days. The trial cannot start until the CEIm confirms that the required insurance or guarantee is in place.
documents.template_note: AEMPS Annex VI: not supplied (see DECISIONS.md, Missing).
documents.drafting_notes_es: CTIS Parte II, sección O. Condicional para la investigación clínica no comercial: el promotor no comercial que cumpla los requisitos puede presentar inicialmente el compromiso firmado del Anexo VI de la AEMPS; el certificado de seguro (ES-O1) debe aportarse en un plazo de 30 días naturales. El ensayo no puede comenzar hasta que el CEIm confirme que el seguro o la garantía exigidos están vigentes. En español.

documents.ctis_title: O2_Proof of coverage_Civil liability certificate_<site or organisation>
documents.name_en: Low-intervention trial civil-liability certificate (AEMPS Annex VII)
documents.trigger_text: Low-intervention trial in which the site's professional civil-liability coverage protects against trial-related harm, so no trial-specific policy is required. If the sponsor buys a specific trial policy instead, submit ES-O1 (Annex VA).
documents.template_note: AEMPS Annex VII: not supplied (see DECISIONS.md, Missing).
documents.signature_note: Signed certificate from the site or organisation representative.
documents.drafting_notes_es: CTIS Parte II, sección O. Condicional para ensayos de bajo nivel de intervención: no se exige póliza específica cuando la responsabilidad civil profesional del centro cubre los daños derivados del ensayo. Presentar el certificado firmado del representante del centro u organización según el Anexo VII de la AEMPS. Si el promotor contrata una póliza específica, presentar el Anexo VA (ES-O1). En español.

documents.ctis_title_note: For a set of individual site budgets add the site: P1_Compensation participants and financial arrangements_<site>_ES. See DECISIONS.md on the P titles.
documents.per: trial (one budget with variable site amounts) or site (set of individual site budgets)
documents.template_note: No AEMPS model is named in the guide and none was supplied (see DECISIONS.md, Missing).
documents.content: One financial budget covering the cost of additional tests, cost per visit and per recruited participant, indirect and administrative costs to be specified in site contracts, free supply of the investigational medicinal products, any additional participant cost and all planned participant and investigator compensation. The amount, nature and payment procedure for participant compensation must be clear. Site contracts are required before site initiation but are not Part II documents.
documents.drafting_notes_es: CTIS Parte II, sección P. Obligatorio: una memoria económica (presupuesto) del ensayo, en español o inglés, sin firma en la presentación. Se acepta un presupuesto único con importes variables por centro o el conjunto de presupuestos individuales por centro. Debe cubrir el coste de las pruebas adicionales, el coste por visita y por participante reclutado, los costes indirectos y administrativos que se especificarán en los contratos con los centros, el suministro gratuito de los medicamentos en investigación, cualquier coste adicional para el participante y todas las compensaciones previstas a participantes e investigadores. Importe, naturaleza y procedimiento de pago de la compensación a participantes deben ser claros y coincidir con la HIP/CI. Los contratos con los centros no se presentan en la Parte II.

documents.trigger_text: The sponsor chooses to add the European compensation-for-participants template when helpful. It does not replace the Spanish financial budget (ES-P1-BUDGET).

template.basis: EU compensation template (CTAG), optional in Spain

documents.content: Travel and expense reimbursement, inconvenience payments, prorating and conditions, identical to the budget and the participant documents.
documents.drafting_notes_es: CTIS Parte II, sección P. Condicional y opcional: la plantilla europea de compensación a participantes puede usarse cuando sea útil, pero no sustituye la memoria económica española (ES-P1-BUDGET). Español o inglés; sin firma. Importes, condiciones, forma de pago y pago proporcional si la participación termina antes deben coincidir con la memoria económica y con cada HIP/CI. Si no se ofrece compensación, indicarlo expresamente.

documents.ctis_title: S1_Compliance collection use storage biological samples_ES
documents.name_en: Compliance with Spanish rules for biological samples (AEMPS Annex XIII)
documents.trigger_text: The trial collects new samples, uses archived material, stores samples or plans future use.

template.basis: EudraLex biological-samples form, used to give the same information as AEMPS Annex XIII (template version 28 January 2022, the accepted Spanish Part II form, not supplied). The guide allows completing Annex XIII "or provide the same information in the dossier with a clear reference". See DECISIONS.md.

documents.content: Samples, quantities, collection procedures, responsible entity, analysis and storage locations, retention, coding, access, transfers, future use, recontact, ethics review and handling of findings. Participant text follows AEMPS Annex VIIIB; optional future use has separate consent logic.
documents.drafting_notes_es: CTIS Parte II, sección S. Condicional: cuando el ensayo obtenga muestras nuevas, use material archivado, almacene muestras o prevea un uso futuro. España acepta el Anexo XIII de la AEMPS en español o inglés (o la misma información en el expediente con una referencia clara); sin firma. Describir muestras, cantidades, procedimientos de obtención, entidad responsable, lugares de análisis y almacenamiento, conservación, codificación, acceso, transferencias (con acuerdo de transferencia de material o equivalente), uso futuro, nuevo contacto, revisión ética y gestión de hallazgos. Las muestras restantes se destruyen al final del ensayo salvo que el participante acepte su almacenamiento e investigación futura; indicar la vía española (biobanco registrado en España, colección registrada en España o repositorio en el extranjero). Debe coincidir con el protocolo, el manual de laboratorio, la HIP/CI (Anexo VIIIB) y el documento de uso futuro.

national_fields.f03: Spain (section 5, national arrangements): remaining samples are destroyed after the trial unless the participant agrees to storage and future research; name the Spanish route for stored samples (biobank registered in Spain, collection registered in Spain, or repository abroad with its legal model, location, access, transfer and purpose) under Royal Decree 1716/2011 and Law 14/2007; the participant text follows AEMPS Annex VIIIB; withdrawal allows destruction or anonymisation of samples.
national_fields.v149: Spain: a biobank registered in Spain releases samples for authorised projects after its scientific and ethics review; future data use beyond the drug development programme needs a favourable ethics-committee opinion or the prior report described in Annex VIIIA.

national_fields_note: national_fields on ES-K1, ES-N1 and ES-S1 give the Spanish additions to the shared forms, keyed by the field id in <form>.fields.json.

population_sets.basis: AEMPS Annex VIIIA model Patient Information Sheet and Informed Consent Form, version 27 February 2025

population_sets.note: Use whenever eligibility is based on health status rather than treatment of a condition. Spain has no separate national healthy-volunteer template: adapt Annex VIIIA. State that no therapeutic benefit is expected; free medicines, tests, monitoring and results are not benefits. Compensation for time and inconvenience only when approved by the CEIm, separate from expense reimbursement, payment due for the part completed on withdrawal, AEMPS tax warning.
population_sets.basis: AEMPS Annex VIIIA adapted for healthy volunteers

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_children under 12_<population>_ES_es
documents.requirement: conditional: when younger children can understand a simple explanation (a child under 12 with sufficient judgment must be heard)

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_adult re-consent_<population>_ES_es
documents.requirement: conditional: participants expected to turn 18 during treatment or follow-up (healthy template for healthy minors)

population_sets.note: Prior consent of the parents not deprived of parental authority or the legal representative. Child under 12: heard when sufficiently mature; record agreement when the child can understand and express a view. From 12: the adolescent also consents and signs (a consent record, not only a simplified leaflet). Adult consent before continuing at 18. One-parent signature valid when the other parent's express or tacit agreement is documented. Optional-use forms follow the same age and representation logic. The assessing CEIm needs paediatric expertise or advice.

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_legal representative_<population>_ES_es
documents.requirement: conditional: when another person must provide consent

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_limited capacity_<population>_ES_es
documents.requirement: mandatory: accessible participant information; also the participant assent or agreement record

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_adult re-consent_<population>_ES_es
documents.requirement: conditional: foreseeable recovery of capacity (acute episode, sedation, critical illness)

population_sets.note: Not because of disability, cognitive impairment or serious illness alone: support the person to consent personally whenever possible. Article 31 CTR conditions. Consent by the legal representative or, as appropriate, a person connected by family or factual relationship (Royal Decree 1090/2015); the site verifies legal authority. Prior instructions are checked and respected. No separate Spanish national representative template: Annex VIIIA includes the signature pathway.

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_emergency deferred consent_<population>_ES_es
documents.requirement: mandatory: subsequent participant PIS/ICF with refusal and data-objection information

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_emergency legal representative_<population>_ES_es
documents.requirement: conditional: participant remains unable to consent after enrolment

population_sets.note: Article 35 CTR and Royal Decree 1090/2015 article 7; approved by the CEIm before use. Family-consultation rule when circumstances permit. Inform as soon as possible; consent to continue and ratification. Right to object to use of data. The emergency enrolment procedure is described in K1 section 6 and the protocol. A short initial information sheet (conditional) has no template: see DECISIONS.md, Missing. Spain publishes no national emergency-consent template.

Only for a participant who can decide but cannot read or write. Not for incapacity, language barriers or emergencies. Witness impartial and unrelated to the study. Annex VIIIA "Informed Consent before witnesses" model; the witness and investigator sign.

Separate form when the planned collection is optional, extends beyond the approved main consent, adds new medical-record access or involves a distinct infant-data decision; otherwise the main PIS pregnancy section covers it. Infant data directly from records need the parent or guardian authorisation (template carries the infant block).

AEMPS requires a specific consent from the pregnant partner of a male participant; the participant cannot consent on her behalf. Independent of the male participant's ICF, with her own privacy rights and contacts. Infant follow-up needs the parent or guardian authorisation.

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_future use data and samples_ES_es

population_sets.note: Future data use outside the drug development programme or for unrelated diseases needs separate consent: a clear yes or no box in the general ICF or a separate form (see DECISIONS.md). Remaining samples are destroyed unless the participant agrees to storage and future research; AEMPS recommends a specific document when samples are obtained for a substudy or future studies. Separate choices for data and for samples. Representative or parent versions when minors or adults unable to consent are included.

AEMPS: if only a defined subpopulation will be invited, a separate information and consent document; an optional substudy open to all participants may be a separate section of the main PIS with a clear yes or no choice. Healthy template for healthy-volunteer trials; same age and representation logic for minors and adults unable to consent.

population_sets_note: population_sets list which templates a kind of population triggers; the actual populations are defined per study (playbook section 2a) and each population gets its own documents.
drafting_rules: Participant documents: AEMPS Annex VIIIA (27 February 2025) is the national model; adapt it to each population rather than translating a generic EU form. Biological-sample text follows AEMPS Annex VIIIB (20 December 2017).
All participant- and representative-facing documents in Spanish only. Translations into other languages for individual participants are the sponsor's responsibility and are not submitted to the CEIm.

Format (AEMPS recommendation): at most 15 pages including the ICF; Arial or Times New Roman, 11 pt or larger; line spacing at least 1.5; normal margins. Personal-data appendix (Annex VIIIA Appendix 1) at most two pages with the same minimums.

Identify study title, study code, EU trial number, sponsor, principal investigator and site; principal investigator and site fields may stay blank for each site to complete before use. The introduction states that the study has received the required CEIm and AEMPS review.

Plain language: explain random allocation, blinding and placebo; no full eligibility list; no protocol schedule pasted in (simple patient-facing table instead); no repetition of routine details or the same discomfort.
Separate routine care from research activities. State whether the medicine is authorised and within its indication; most frequent and most serious risks; unknown risks may exist; procedure risks.
Benefits only when supported; the participant may receive no benefit; free medicine, tests, results and closer follow-up are not benefits. List main alternatives, including not joining.

Withdrawal never requires a signed revocation form; if the protocol has one, say that withdrawal is valid without signing it. Distinguish leaving visits, withdrawing trial consent and withdrawing optional future-use consent; data and samples are not used in later analyses after withdrawal unless another lawful route or new consent applies.

Costs and compensation: no cost for study medicines or trial-specific tests; amount or calculation, payment method and proportional payment on early end; AEMPS warning that compensation is income for Spanish tax purposes; match the financial budget. Insurance: cover meeting Royal Decree 1090/2015 and how to get more information; match the actual Spanish insurance route.
Pregnancy: specific pregnancy and breastfeeding section when participants or partners could become pregnant; contraception only as in the protocol; partner data only through her own specific consent.

Data protection: Annex VIIIA Appendix 1 inside each participant document (not a separate upload); legally required trial processing is not presented as depending on an optional GDPR consent; 25-year sponsor and investigator retention; no promise of deletion where retention is required.

Consent form: handwritten name, signature and date of participant and investigator at consent; confirms the participant read the PIS and data-protection appendix, could ask questions, received enough information, understood voluntariness and agrees. Blank at CTIS submission; the participant receives the PIS and a signed and dated copy.
CTIS titles carry no version or date (CTCG naming guide v3.0 wins over the guide's "titles with version and date"); version and date go in the document footer and the CTIS metadata.

Participant templates (JSON): italic text, [square-bracket] and <<double-angle>> notes and "..........." gaps are drafting instructions or gaps; follow them and remove them. Part II templates (DOCX): yellow [INSERT/IF/OTHERWISE/CHOOSE/NOTE: …] labels. Nothing of either may remain in a final document.

naming.convention: content/playbook/naming.md (CTCG Best Practice Guide: Naming of Documents in CTIS, v3.0, 10 February 2026)
naming.spain_note: Use the CTCG pattern. The Spain guide asks for "clear descriptive titles with version and date" for PIS/ICF; the newer CTCG v3.0 puts version and date in CTIS metadata, never in the title, so titles carry no version or date (version and date stay in the document footer). Participant-facing documents carry _ES_es; country-level documents carry _ES as in the naming-guide examples; the language code is added only where it distinguishes the document.

document_kinds.form: Regulatory form the assistant answers question by question. Keep the template layout and questions unchanged.
document_kinds.participant_document: Participant- or representative-facing document written section by section from a participant template, for one population.
document_kinds.third_party_template: Template completed by someone else (investigator). The assistant fills only trial fields (title, EU trial number) and leaves every other field empty for that person.
document_kinds.third_party_document: Document issued by someone else (insurer, sponsor, site, finance). Recorded as a source when received; only checked.
document_kinds.ctis_data: Information entered as structured data in CTIS; checked against the plan.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Assent Form - Adolescents
participant_templates.name_es: Hoja de información y consentimiento informado para adolescentes
participant_templates.role: age-adapted information and consent for adolescents 12-17 (the adolescent's own consent; Spanish rule from age 12)
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving adolescent participants (aged 12 - 17 years).

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Assent Form - Children
participant_templates.name_es: Hoja de información y asentimiento para niños
participant_templates.role: age-adapted information and assent record for children under 12 (template band 6-11; see population_rules.minors)
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving children participants (aged 6 - 11 years).

participant_templates.name_en: Emergency Enrolment and Deferred Consent Form
participant_templates.name_es: Hoja de información y consentimiento diferido en situación de urgencia
participant_templates.role: subsequent information and consent after emergency enrolment
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves emergency enrolment before prior informed consent because neither the participant nor a legal representative can provide consent within the required treatment window.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Consent Form - Healthy Adults
participant_templates.name_es: Hoja de información al participante y consentimiento informado
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving healthy adult participants (18 or older without a specific health condition). Can be used for non-treated participants when no other template applies.

participant_templates.name_en: Trial Information and Consent Form - Legal Representative
participant_templates.name_es: Hoja de información y consentimiento del representante
participant_templates.role: information and consent for the legal representative, family member or related person of an adult unable to consent
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves adult participants who cannot provide informed consent and participation must be authorised by a legally authorised representative.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Assent Form - Limited Capacity
participant_templates.name_es: Hoja de información y expresión de voluntad
participant_templates.role: accessible information and expression of will for the adult unable to consent
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves an adult lacking consent capacity who retains sufficient understanding to receive adapted information and express assent, willingness or objection. It accompanies the legal representative’s consent.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Consent Form - Adult Patients
participant_templates.name_es: Hoja de información al paciente y consentimiento informado
participant_templates.role: main information and consent (capable adult patients); also re-consent at 18, regained capacity and substudy documents
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving adult patients (18 or older & diagnosed with a specific health condition). Can be used for patients when no other template applies such as re-consent after reaching adulthood, regained capacity, prescreening, or optional substudies or extension arms.

participant_templates.name_en: Trial Information and Consent Form - Parents
participant_templates.name_es: Hoja de información y consentimiento informado para padres/tutores
participant_templates.role: information and consent for parents or legal guardians of a minor
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving minor participants (younger than 18 years).

participant_templates.name_es: Hoja de información y consentimiento para el seguimiento del embarazo y del bebé
participant_templates.role: pregnancy and infant follow-up of a pregnant participant
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves collection of pregnancy outcome, maternal-health or infant-health information from a pregnant trial participant.

participant_templates.name_es: Hoja de información y consentimiento para el seguimiento del embarazo de la pareja
participant_templates.role: specific information and consent for the pregnant partner of a male participant
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves collection of pregnancy outcome, maternal-health or infant-health information from the pregnant partner of a male trial participant.

participant_templates.name_en: Secondary and Future Use of Data or Biosamples
participant_templates.name_es: Información y consentimiento para el uso futuro de datos y muestras
participant_templates.role: optional future use of data or samples
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves optional storage or secondary use of participant data, biological samples or genetic material beyond the mandatory purposes of the main clinical trial.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Consent Form - Impartial Witness
participant_templates.name_es: Hoja de información al paciente y consentimiento informado ante testigo imparcial
participant_templates.role: consent before an impartial witness for a capable participant unable to read or write
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves an adult participant who has capacity to consent but cannot read, write or sign the standard consent form. The participant decides personally, while an impartial witness confirms and documents the consent process.

population_rules.authority: AEMPS Annex VIIIA, Guideline for Correct Preparation of a Model Patient Information Sheet and Informed Consent Form, version 27 February 2025; Royal Decree 1090/2015 articles 3 to 8; Spanish Civil Code article 156; Law 41/2002 on Patient Autonomy; Regulation (EU) No 536/2014 articles 28 to 35

age_bands.rule: Parents or legal representative consent first. The child is heard when sufficiently mature; information adapted to age and maturity; the child's agreement is recorded when the child can understand and express a view. Prepared when younger children can understand a simple explanation.
age_bands.conflict_resolved: The template is labelled 6-11; the authority sets no lower age, only "younger than 12" with sufficient judgment. The authority wins: the band is "under 12"; the 6-11 template is used for any child under 12 able to understand a simple explanation, adapted to the reader. Recorded in templates/README.md.

age_bands.rule: Mandatory from age 12: parent or legal-representative consent and the adolescent's own consent, with the adolescent's signature and date; the same material decision points as the parent document in age-appropriate language.
age_bands.conflict_resolved: The template's English name and instructions call it an assent document; the authority requires the adolescent's own consent ("not only a simplified leaflet with no consent record"). The authority wins: the document records consent (consentimiento), as its Spanish title already says.

minors.reaching_12: A child who enters under 12 and turns 12 during the trial receives the adolescent document and gives their own consent before continuing.
minors.reconsent_at_18: ES-PT-main or ES-PT-healthy: express adult consent before continued participation; plan the visit, version and timing before the birthday.
minors.parent_signature: One parent may sign when the other parent's express or tacit agreement is sufficiently documented. Record one of: both parents sign; one parent signs and confirms the other does not object; the signer is the sole legal guardian. Do not require two signatures on every form; do not accept one signature without the documented basis. A non-parent legal representative is identified and the authority relied on is evidenced per site procedure.
minors.note: An explicit refusal or wish to withdraw by a minor able to form and evaluate an opinion is respected even if a parent signed. Parent permission for the main trial is not permission for optional activities. AEMPS points to the KIDS Barcelona young-person guidance as a recommended aid.

adults_without_capacity.reconsent_on_capacity: ES-PT-main or ES-PT-healthy when capacity is regained: the participant's own consent before continuing.
adults_without_capacity.note: Use the representative pathway only when the adult cannot understand, retain, use or communicate the information despite suitable support; capacity is decision-specific and may change. Prior instructions given while capable are respected. Representative: legal representative or, as appropriate, a person connected by family or factual relationship; not any relative by default. Explicit objection, non-verbal resistance or distress is respected and documented.

emergency.representative: ES-PT-legal-rep when the participant remains unable to consent after enrolment.
emergency.note: When the participant regains capacity, their own decision governs; do not rely on representative consent. If minors or adults unable to consent are eligible, the emergency plan covers them.

separate_document_rules: The pregnant partner of a male participant gives a specific consent in her own document (AEMPS); the participant cannot consent for her.

An optional substudy for a defined subpopulation gets a separate information and consent document (AEMPS); a substudy open to all participants may be a separate section of the main PIS with its own yes or no choice.
Future data use outside the drug development programme or for unrelated diseases needs separate consent: an independent yes or no box in the general ICF or a separate form (AEMPS).

Storage and future use of remaining samples needs the participant's agreement; otherwise they are destroyed. AEMPS recommends a specific document when samples are obtained for a substudy or future studies.
Each materially different optional purpose has its own choice (at minimum main trial, future data use, future sample storage; also optional biopsies, genetic research, recontact); no bundled consent.
Participant pregnancy follow-up needs a separate form when it is optional, extends beyond the main consent, adds medical-record access or involves a distinct infant-data decision.
